One bright morning, <name> was playing in the backyard when he spotted a tiny, crumpled map under a flowerpot.

“What’s this?” he wondered, smoothing it out. The map showed colorful drawings of flowers, stones, and footprints leading to a hidden spot.

Excited, <name> followed a trail of bright marigolds, tiptoeing past the swing and around the little garden pond. Suddenly, a butterfly with sparkling wings fluttered ahead. “I’ll follow you!” he giggled, running softly so he wouldn’t scare it away.

Next, a line of shiny pebbles led toward the big mango tree. <name> crawled under the branches, following the trail carefully. A playful garden cat darted past, and he laughed as he chased it for a few steps, careful not to startle it.

At last, he arrived at a small patch of grass tucked behind the tree. There, glimmering in the sunlight, was a painted rock with a smiling sun!

“Wow! My treasure!” <name> cheered, holding it up proudly.

He realized that by observing the clues, thinking carefully, and following the little trails, even a simple backyard could become a magical adventure full of surprises.
